scope: 0254 and 0255 use full application chatTurn with persisted conversation, clarification, actual model on the answer, automatic transaction and final saved confirmation. 0256 and 0258 use actual planner/executor. fixes: Missing status/outcome requests ask for the value before mutations.
Clarification continuation is scoped to the same prospect and next answer; cancellation does not inherit authorization.
Continuation loads workflow tools with discovery available instead of exhausting initial input reservation.
appendNote preserves existing notes; transaction and idempotency key prevent duplicate appends.
Executor confirmation includes actual saved contact outcome, collaboration status and appended note.
limitations: 99 originals have local evidence, not a guarantee of perfect execution across variants.
